messages:
Maya P: Quick async standup — starting canary for ff-routing-v2 at 5% in prod (us-east-1). Smoke tests passed. Observed nominal latency +1.2ms at p50, p95 up ~8ms. No errors in logs so far. Holding for 30m. Ping if you see anything. :eyes:

Sahil: Can you paste the canary config? also where is the rollout flag? cc @Lucy

Maya P: Sure — config pasted below:
```yaml
feature_flag: ff-routing-v2
canary:
  percent: 5
  regions: [us-east-1]
  health_checks:
    - smoke
    - 1m p95 < 200ms
rollback_policy: auto: false
promote_after: 30m
```

ops-bot: Canary Monitor: rollout=5% started at 2026-03-17T14:02:10Z. smoke_checks=ok, errors=0. metric_deltas: p95 +8.2ms; mem +3%. Will report again at +10m.

Jamie: Saw an isolated p95 spike to +40ms on us-east-1b ~14:05 UTC, traced to host-3. Not fleet-wide, but worth watching.

Lucy: fyi the client variant patch (client >=2.1 gating) hasn't rolled to mobile yet — old clients still get v1. That could cause routing mismatches if we change tables. Recommend a short server-side gate: `client_version >= 2.1` until mobile lands.

Priya: QA running regression suite against canary now. No functional failures observed so far. Can we freeze further flag changes until we decide on promotion?

Sahil: I'll keep an eye on host-3 and can evict it from the pool if it keeps spiking. :thumbsup:

Maya P: Good call on the freeze. If anything crosses thresholds we rollback to baseline immediately. Rollback runbook (quick): `rbctl rollback ff-routing-v2 --to baseline` -> notify #eng-oncall -> validate. Typical time ~2m.

Jamie: Also request: enable automatic diversion to baseline if error rate >0.5% over 5m for this canary. Tagging ops-bot to create the rule.

ops-bot: Alert rule created: `divert-to-baseline` if errors > 0.5% over 5m. Notifications to #eng-runtime and #incidents.

Maya P: Thanks team — next manual check-in at +30m (will post timestamp). If stable we promote to 25%. Thx. :rocket:
